description: The nearest populated places (GeoNames cities500: 500 inhabitants or more, or a seat of government) with distance in km, population and path, nearest first. 503 NOT_READY on a dataset built before the feature. Works without a key within a smaller daily free quota (100 calls per network).

lang.description: Comma-separated BCP 47 tags (max 5), e.g. en,de. Adds `names`; null means we do not have that language.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, from -90 to 90.

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, from -180 to 180.

radius.description: Kilometres, default 100; places farther away are not returned

name: find_nearby_places
title: Nearby places
